autologin.chat.no-accounts: No saved login for this server yet.
autologin.chat.configure.tip: Open the AutoLogin settings and saved logins
autologin.chat.retry: That password did not work. Pick another, or edit it in the settings.
autologin.chat.unsendable: AutoLogin: that password cannot be sent as a command.
autologin.chat.list.empty: AutoLogin: no saved logins. Add one in the AutoLogin settings.
text.autoconfig.autologin.title: AutoLogin settings
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.enabled: Watch server messages for login prompts.
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.autoLog: Send the password as soon as a prompt is detected, instead of showing options in chat.
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.preferr: Label to use when several logins match. Empty means the first matching row.
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.account: One per row: label|server|password. server may be * for every server. A password typed into /register is saved here automatically.
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.chatLis: When auto-login cannot decide, print clickable options in chat.
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.detectI: Only useful for testing the detector with /say.
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.debug.@: Log every rule that fires, and why a prompt was skipped.
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.customR: One per line: KIND regex. KIND is LOGIN, REGISTER or AUTHENTICATED. Example: LOGIN ^Please /login <password>
autologin.chat.saved: AutoLogin: saved this server's password as %s.
